scope: Generated papers, images and synthetic keys in isolated Edge. Test-only all-host grant enables screenshot capture. No user profile or live AI. Generated code is not executed.

results.name: Memory defaults off; no credentials or API configuration in research state
Explicit webpage capture extracts article, captions, raster and visible SVG without calling AI
Offscreen image loads only after explicit action; image domain and MIME validation apply
Custom Skills save, import, export and reject stale edits or invalid batch imports
Paper analysis applies selected Skill, streams safe text and does not save when memory is off
Opt-in remembers completed analyses; another page includes bounded notebook context
Memory can be omitted per request; notebook boundaries do not leak prior paper context
Recognized webpage figures generate downloadable Python and R drafts with original-data requirements
Settings export JSON and Markdown retain sources, omit API credentials and all images
Deleting a notebook while analysis is pending prevents late recreation of its records
Stopping paper analysis aborts HTTP and does not store partial results
PDF paper analysis spans pages and figure source remains page one after navigation
DOCX, TXT and Markdown analysis use the same Skills and notebook workflow
Storage enforces context budget, expiry and capacity; independent records survive worker/browser restart
Research messages reject website callers; malformed input and missing code evidence send no AI request
Successful analysis remains downloadable and shows an actionable memory-save failure
Long article extraction preserves separators and every paragraph without a character cutoff
Document image overview supports batch selection and removal; replacing the document clears selection and search without AI
No uncaught browser errors; all generated-code results remain inert text
